build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a tower of dynamic bars with configurable height and width
create_dynamic_bodies: create dynamic bars and balls in a PHYRE scene using C.add with scale and angle parameters
create_static_obstacles: create static bars as slopes, walls, and blocks to constrain ball movement in the scene
update_task_goal: update the task goal so the ball must touch the tower base using C.update_task with TOUCHING relationship
set_solution_metadata: set the solution tier metadata to PRE_TWO_BALLS using C.set_meta on the task context
